Why locals call Josh first

Not every crew finishes what they start

Every point below comes straight from customers who've had us in their yard — not marketing copy.

On time, every time

Josh turns up when he says he will and gets straight into the job — no chasing, no rescheduling.

Fair, honest pricing

Quoted up front, no surprises after the truck's already in your driveway. Reasonable rates, every job.

Full clean-up, no mess left

Greenwaste hauled, lawns raked, gutters cleared. The yard looks better than when we found it.

Careful around power lines and fences

Rotted limbs over roofs, natives against the boundary, palms near power lines — handled without drama.

What we do

Tree work, start to finish

One call covers the whole job — cutting, grinding, hedging and hauling it all away.

Tree removal & pruning

Full removals, canopy reduction, and pruning back overgrown natives to a manageable size.

Stump grinding

Old stumps ground below the surface so you can turf, plant or pave straight over the top.

Hedging

Boundary hedges and screening trimmed square and tidy, kept to the height you actually want.

Greenwaste removal

Everything we cut gets chipped or hauled offsite the same day — nothing left piled on your lawn.

Rubbish removal

Old furniture, garden waste, general clean-up junk — one trip and it's gone.
